items.title: OPLN or RACE: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
items.summary: A comparison of OPENLANE (OPLN) and Ferrari (RACE) in the Automotive - Original Equipment sector reveals that OPLN is the more attractive value investment. OPLN has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with a forward P/E of 24.42 and Value grade of A, while RACE has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) with a forward P/E of 38.04 and Value grade of D. OPLN's superior valuation metrics and improving earnings outlook make it the better choice for value investors.

items.title: FERRARI N.V.: PERIODIC REPORT ON THE BUYBACK PROGRAM
items.summary: Ferrari N.V. announced the purchase of 43,000 common shares between October 5-9, 2026, as part of its €250 million third tranche share buyback program. The company invested €114.8 million at an average price of €344.08 per share on Euronext Milan. Since January 2026, Ferrari has purchased 2,032,307 shares for a total consideration of €627.7 million under its multi-year €3.5 billion buyback initiative expected to conclude by 2030.
